name: Warning!
source:
Turning on pc as usual. Some strange man appears on the screen. "My name is Desktop Master. Please accept the challenge". The next thing I notice is that I'm at school at night and need to find the password parts to return to original world as soon as possible. Only three hours are given.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
